away.name: Joel Hofer
away.news: Jordan Binnington led the Blues to their first Stanley Cup in the 2018-19 season, but he has struggled to perform at a consistently high level. Last season, the Blues gave an increased workload to Joel Hofer, who eventually outplayed Binnington in the latter half of the season and earned more playing time. Building on that trend, the Blues turned to Hofer in their season opener, and he stopped all 25 shots he faced in a 4-0 win over the Dallas Stars, adding to his case for the team's starting goalie. The Blues enter Tuesday as -140 road favourites against a Chicago Blackhawks team that has been outscored 15-5 in its first three games (0-3-0).

home.name: Spencer Knight
home.news: Knight had a solid first full season with the Blackhawks in 2025-26, posting a serviceable 2.82 GAA and .902 SV% in 55 games (19-25-11). That said, the 25-year-old goalie has struggled out of the gate in 2026-27, as has his team, which is still without Connor Bedard (shoulder), posting an ugly 4.04 GAA and .875 SV% in two outings (0-2-0). The Blackhawks aren't expected to be the epitome of team defence this season, but they struggled last year as well, and Knight still performed well, so they will hope he showcases that same talent this year. The Blackhawks enter Tuesday's contest as +127 home favourites against a St. Louis Blues team off to a 1-1-0 start this season.

away.name: Jacob Markstrom
away.news: The Panthers have high expectations for Markstrom after acquiring him in an offseason trade, and they'll turn to him to tend the twine for the third time in four games. The 36-year-old Swedish goalie has been solid early in his return to Florida, the team that drafted him in 2008, posting a 1.40 GAA and .914 SV% in two games (1-0-1). The Panthers enter Tuesday as -114 road favourites against a Los Angeles Kings team that has been outscored 13-8 through two games (0-1-1).

home.name: Darcy Kuemper
home.news: Kuemper had a disappointing 2025-26 season, posting a 2.78 GAA and an ugly .891 SV% in 50 games (19-14-15), and did very little to reassure Kings fans that he has returned to form in 2026-27. The veteran 36-year-old goalie had a terrible season-opener, allowing eight goals on 29 shots (.724 SV%) in an 8-4 loss to the Colorado Avalanche. Kuemper hopes for a better result on Tuesday, as the Kings enter action as +106 home underdogs against a Florida Panthers team that has struggled offensively to start the season, scoring just six goals through three games (1-0-2).

away.name: Carter Hart
away.news: Hart led the Golden Knights onto the ice for warmups; he'll start Tuesday in Seattle.

home.name: Joey Daccord
home.news: Daccord has been excellent to start the 2026-27 season, starting two of Seattle's first three games, and will likely return to the crease on Tuesday against the Vegas Golden Knights. The 30-year-old Daccord has opened the season by saving 56 of 58 shots (.966 SV%) in his first two games (2-0-0). Daccord had a down 2025-26 season, but he'll hope to return to the impressive form he showed in prior years. Seattle enters Tuesday's contest as +148 home underdogs.
